findings.highlight: I start mixing
findings.evidenceJa: ぺったんぺったん
findings.governingReading: The breakfast opens with repeated patting and kneading sounds before the ingredient list.
findings.explanation: I start mixing removes the domestic sound play and changes kneading into generic mixing.

findings.highlight: the beef and pork
findings.evidenceJa: 挽肉四百グラム
findings.governingReading: Shirou combines the seasoned mixture with exactly four hundred grams of ground meat.
findings.explanation: The English omits the exact quantity used to frame the recipe.

findings.highlight: beef and pork
findings.evidenceJa: 挽肉
findings.governingReading: The source specifies ground meat without identifying its animal composition.
findings.explanation: The English invents a beef-and-pork blend.

findings.highlight: Japanese-style hamburger
findings.evidenceJa: 和風煮込みハンバーグ
findings.governingReading: Breakfast is Japanese-style simmered hamburger steak, a plated stewed dish.
findings.explanation: Hamburger commonly denotes a sandwich and omits both the steak form and simmered preparation.

findings.highlight: only normally witted
findings.evidenceJa: 人並みに目端が利くだけ
findings.governingReading: Rin claims she is merely as quick and observant as an ordinary person.
findings.explanation: Normally witted is nonidiomatic and shifts alert perception toward general intelligence.

findings.highlight: takes position at the table
findings.evidenceJa: テーブルにどかーっと陣取った
findings.governingReading: Rin plunks herself down and expansively occupies the table like royalty.
findings.explanation: Takes position removes the comic force, sound, and bodily sprawl of her occupation.

findings.highlight: Lancer’s Master is still a mystery
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーもアサシンも一筋縄でいく相手ではない
findings.governingReading: Saber says neither Lancer nor Assassin is an opponent who can be handled straightforwardly.
findings.explanation: The English conditionally substitutes an unsupported claim about Lancer’s Master being a mystery.

findings.highlight: conveniently altered
findings.evidenceJa: 都合よく改竄された
findings.governingReading: Rin treats legends as records conveniently falsified or tampered with.
findings.explanation: Altered weakens the deliberate falsification expressed by 改竄.

findings.highlight: The great hero of England
findings.evidenceJa: 英国における英雄の代名詞
findings.governingReading: Arthur is the very byword or epitome of a hero in Britain.
findings.explanation: Great hero preserves stature but loses the claim that Arthur defines the category.

findings.highlight: her own army that she protected
findings.evidenceJa: 守るべき自国の軍
findings.governingReading: The unexpected enemy is the army of her own country that the king was duty-bound to protect.
findings.explanation: That she protected changes normative obligation into a completed past action.

findings.highlight: a betrayal by the ones she trusted
findings.evidenceJa: 腹心の裏切り
findings.governingReading: The disaster begins with betrayal by a close confidant or trusted retainer.
findings.explanation: The ones pluralizes the betrayer and removes the specific retainer relationship.

findings.highlight: had to defeat them
findings.evidenceJa: これを殲滅した
findings.governingReading: Arthur annihilates the knights who attack her after the betrayal.
findings.explanation: Defeat softens the total destruction of her own army.

findings.highlight: Throw this sword into that lake
findings.evidenceJa: この剣を沈める
findings.governingReading: Arthur orders Bedivere to sink the sword in the deep lake.
findings.explanation: Throw into states entry into the lake but omits the required submergence.

findings.highlight: asleep right now
findings.evidenceJa: 和室で寝てる
findings.governingReading: Rin identifies the dangerous child sleeping in the Japanese-style room.
findings.explanation: The English omits Illya’s location within the house.

findings.highlight: It is not a wise decision
findings.evidenceJa: シロウはどうかしています
findings.governingReading: Saber says Shirou himself is acting irrationally or is out of his mind for sheltering Illya.
findings.explanation: The English relocates her judgment from Shirou’s state to the abstract quality of the decision.

findings.highlight: I was the one who carried her
findings.evidenceJa: 一人でイリヤを背負ってきた
findings.governingReading: Because Rin and Saber objected, Shirou carried unconscious Illya home on his own back.
findings.explanation: The English keeps his sole responsibility but omits the physical manner of carrying her.

findings.highlight: remove her Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: その令呪を剥奪
findings.governingReading: Saber argues that Illya’s remaining Command Spells should be stripped from her.
findings.explanation: The singular makes the command system sound like one spell rather than her set of seals or authorities.

findings.highlight: Saber glares at me
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐに睨んでくる
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese begins with Shirou registering Saber’s seriousness; the direct glare line is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores the deleted hostile staging.

findings.highlight: she was acting strangely
findings.evidenceJa: 様子もおかしかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Illya was still a child and her condition or appearance was abnormal after Berserker vanished.
findings.explanation: Acting strangely makes the concern about her state sound like suspicious voluntary behavior.

findings.highlight: after what she did to us
findings.evidenceJa: あの子にあんな目にあわされて
findings.governingReading: Rin asks how Shirou can still say this after what Illya put him through.
findings.explanation: Us broadens the victim from Shirou and weakens the personal basis of Rin’s incredulity.

findings.highlight: someone there to tell her what’s right
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと言いつけてやるヤツ
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes Illya could change if someone properly instructed and restrained her.
findings.explanation: Tell her what’s right moralizes the intervention and omits the practical authority or discipline he imagines.

findings.highlight: Illya admitted it. She killed Shinji.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは言った。俺が逃がした慎二をその手で殺めたと。
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls that Illya said she killed the Shinji whom he had allowed to escape.
findings.explanation: Admitted turns a reported statement into a confession and endorses it as established truth.

findings.highlight: If those were his intentions as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: それがマスターとしての行為だったのなら
findings.governingReading: Shirou conditionally treats Shinji’s conduct as conduct performed in his capacity as a Master.
findings.explanation: Intentions replaces outward conduct with an inferred mental state.

findings.highlight: You’re a failure as a Master if you worry about that sort of a thing.
findings.evidenceJa: マスター失格ね、リン
findings.governingReading: Illya ends the taunt by addressing Rin directly by name.
findings.explanation: The omitted name removes the pointed personal address that sharpens Illya’s provocation.

findings.highlight: you two have no modesty
findings.evidenceJa: たしなみってものがない
findings.governingReading: Illya accuses the older women of lacking the manners or cultivated propriety expected of ladies.
findings.explanation: Modesty narrows social refinement into personal or sexual reserve.

findings.highlight: Illya shrugs her shoulders as if to show her shock.
findings.evidenceJa: 心底呆れたようにイリヤは肩をすくめる
findings.governingReading: Illya shrugs as though thoroughly exasperated or appalled by the others.
findings.explanation: Shock substitutes surprise for her performed worldly exasperation.

findings.highlight: …Is this an illusion?
findings.evidenceJa: ……それは、どんな幻だろう。
findings.governingReading: The illusion reaction is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores narration removed from the source.

findings.highlight: Illya pinches the end of her skirt in a polite manner and bows to me respectfully.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは行儀良くスカートの端を指につまむと、恭しくお辞儀をしてきた。
findings.governingReading: The skirt-pinching curtsy is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted physical staging and doubles the formal-performance cues.

findings.highlight: I choke at the surprise attack.
findings.evidenceJa: 不意打ちにむせる俺。
findings.governingReading: The narration that Shirou chokes at the surprise is commented out; the active Japanese immediately gives Rin’s milk-choking reaction.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores Shirou’s deleted reaction before Rin’s active one.

findings.highlight: Saber gets mad, but keeps a straight face.
findings.evidenceJa: びきり、と真顔でこめかみのあたりに効果音を鳴らすセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber remains straight-faced while an imagined snapping or throbbing sound effect appears by her temple.
findings.explanation: The English states anger directly and removes the visual-auditory gag that lets her rigid face carry it indirectly.

findings.highlight: A Servant is a hundred years too early to give me her opinion.
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントのクセにわたしに意見しようなんて百年早いわ
findings.governingReading: Illya uses the idiom “a hundred years too soon” to say a mere Servant has no standing to object to her.
findings.explanation: The English copies Japanese syntax into a malformed sentence and obscures the status insult.

findings.highlight: The two’s staredown doesn’t end.
findings.evidenceJa: 二人のにらみ合いは終わらない
findings.governingReading: The mutual glare between the two of them continues.
findings.explanation: The two’s is an ungrammatical possessive construction for a reciprocal action.

findings.highlight: and says in a disinterested manner
findings.evidenceJa: どうでもよさげに口にした
findings.governingReading: The manner clause is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores a deleted gloss of Rin’s manner.

findings.highlight: The two look at my face in surprise.
findings.evidenceJa: はてな？　と俺の顔を覗き込む二人
findings.governingReading: The two peer into Shirou’s face with puzzled question-mark expressions.
findings.explanation: Surprise replaces puzzlement and look drops the close peering action.

findings.highlight: Yes.
findings.evidenceJa: さもありなん
findings.governingReading: Shirou dryly concedes that this is only to be expected.
findings.explanation: Yes removes the causal, sardonic force of “no wonder.”

findings.highlight: The hamburger I was making
findings.evidenceJa: ぺたぺたと挽き肉をこねて作っていたハンバーグ
findings.governingReading: Shirou identifies the hamburger steaks he had been making by patting and kneading ground meat.
findings.explanation: Hamburger again suggests a sandwich and drops the tactile preparation that reconnects the scene to breakfast.

findings.highlight: I feel like I’m sitting on a cushion full of needles.
findings.evidenceJa: 針の筵に座っている気分
findings.governingReading: Shirou invokes the established image of sitting on a mat or bed of needles.
findings.explanation: Cushion changes the object and blunts the conventional image of acute social discomfort.

findings.highlight: I have to make up my mind and escape the current situation.
findings.evidenceJa: 現状を打破しなくてはなるまい
findings.governingReading: Shirou resolves to break the present deadlock.
findings.explanation: Escape recasts resolving the group’s dispute as personally fleeing it.

findings.highlight: Let’s decide.
findings.evidenceJa: 話をつけよう
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls on the group to settle the matter.
findings.explanation: Decide is incomplete English here and loses the sense of reaching a settlement.

findings.highlight: Morning will end if we keep on like this.
findings.evidenceJa: いつまでもこうしてちゃ昼になっちまう
findings.governingReading: Shirou warns that it will become noon if they keep this up.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the concrete noon deadline with the vaguer end of morning.

findings.highlight: …Well, I guess it can’t be helped since Illya was the most difficult enemy for Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: ……まあ、セイバーから見ればイリヤは最も厄介な敵だったんだから仕方がないんだろうけど。
findings.governingReading: The explanatory claim that Illya was Saber’s most troublesome enemy is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted interpretation of Saber’s resistance.

findings.highlight: Illya asks me innocently.
findings.evidenceJa: はてな、とイリヤは純真に訊いてくる
findings.governingReading: The narration explicitly glossing Illya’s question as innocent is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally supplies an innocence judgment the active source leaves to performance.

findings.highlight: we’re wondering what you’re going to do now
findings.evidenceJa: この後どうしたものかなって
findings.governingReading: Shirou says they are discussing what should be done about Illya after she lost her Servant.
findings.explanation: The English makes Illya the agent who must decide what she will do, obscuring that the others are deciding her disposition.
